narrative:
Rare disease revenue is patient-driven. The volume model tracks treated patients by brand-indication and market over six half-years, from H1 FY25 to H2 FY27, with net revenue per patient linking every curve back to the revenue targets.

gMG is the steepest curve: diagnosis-to-treatment time has fallen from 14 to 9 months, and FcRn competitor uptake is slower than modelled. Koselugo in China accelerates after the NRDL listing. Strensiq adult HPP gains from the screening programme.

Soliris PNH patients in Europe decline as they switch to Ultomiris or to biosimilars. That switch is captured here as volume and priced in Launch & Lifecycle.

signals.title: gMG Claims Analysis — Diagnosis-to-Treatment Time
signals.excerpt: Median time from gMG diagnosis to complement inhibitor start fell from 14 to 9 months. AChR+ antibody testing up 22% YoY.

signals.title: FcRn Competitive Landscape Update
signals.excerpt: FcRn blocker uptake in gMG slower than modelled. Ultomiris retains share in AChR+ gMG with 8-weekly maintenance dosing.

signals.title: Koselugo China NRDL Listing
signals.excerpt: Koselugo on the NRDL from January; 38 additional tertiary hospitals onboarded for paediatric NF1-PN.
